corpus.content: KnowledgeHub Security Standard: All communication requires TLS 1.3 encryption. Passwords must be hashed using bcrypt with cost factor 12. Authentication tokens expire in 60 minutes. Multi-tenancy is enforced at the database level with workspace isolation.

Disaster Recovery Playbook: Database snapshots are taken every 24 hours at 00:00 UTC and replicated to secondary cloud regions. Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is 1 hour. Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is 15 minutes.
Employee Handbook: Standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST. Remote work is permitted for up to 3 days per week upon manager approval. Annual paid time off is 20 business days.
